v_70a8507099.speaker: walt
v_70a8507099.text: A long car at the drive-thru?

v_8bcaa6bb04.speaker: walt
v_8bcaa6bb04.text: Also, if someone knocks at the door... it's not me, lock it.

v_8c48d35c08.speaker: walt
v_8c48d35c08.text: And don't stay outside too long.

v_2022c4e32e.speaker: walt
v_2022c4e32e.text: Cheese is in. Folks love cheese.

v_07f1b13880.speaker: walt
v_07f1b13880.text: Do you see that lever? Go there and pull it to open the store.

v_6ea4e48840.speaker: walt
v_6ea4e48840.text: Evening, Rookie. Some customers look off.

v_3c84ea3eda.speaker: walt
v_3c84ea3eda.text: Get off the floor. Climb the counter.

v_643427f920.speaker: walt
v_643427f920.text: Hello, Rookie! My name is Walt. I've noticed that you're new here, so I'm gonna walk you through this.

v_8b2fd70edd.speaker: walt
v_8b2fd70edd.text: Hey Rookie, if you see the raincoat lady, I love her, serve her and be nice to her.

v_4d28b6c67f.speaker: walt
v_4d28b6c67f.text: Hot dog's ready. Wait for orders.

v_b938f43cf2.speaker: walt
v_b938f43cf2.text: I counted the lamps. It helps.

v_b85c836266.speaker: walt
v_b85c836266.text: I watched every one. From in here. Best seat in town.

v_0520e8b100.speaker: walt
v_0520e8b100.text: I worked that corner forty years. Since '.

v_05009b919e.speaker: walt
v_05009b919e.text: If the lights turn off, the breaker is outside, go there and fix it.

v_951af0016c.speaker: walt
v_951af0016c.text: If you hear steps at the roof, it's probably a cat. Don't look up.

v_03a5b65398.speaker: walt
v_03a5b65398.text: If you run out of ingredients, take it in the back.

v_3c75317b9b.speaker: walt
v_3c75317b9b.text: If you see someone shaking, he's probably just hungry, give him a bread.

v_0b0655a682.speaker: walt
v_0b0655a682.text: If you see someone with no face, just don't make any questions. Ignore him and he will leave.

v_6e89e13998.speaker: walt
v_6e89e13998.text: If you see someone with white eyes, TURN OFF THE LIGHTS, and give them the food, they are light sensitive

v_38eb8400bb.speaker: walt
v_38eb8400bb.text: If you see the customer with a big head, give them the food fast, they have a headache. And also, a red fog might show up, so close the window if it happens.

v_71c594aea2.speaker: walt
v_71c594aea2.text: It'll keep your head on straight.

v_8df981736c.speaker: walt
v_8df981736c.text: It's 6 AM, your shift is over. Go outside and check if you find anything useful.

v_a5a48fc8ed.speaker: walt
v_a5a48fc8ed.text: Keep it off till they're back.

v_a2fdcbe997.speaker: walt
v_a2fdcbe997.text: Keep the rules, and they stay polite. That's the deal.

v_67ad984e40.speaker: walt
v_67ad984e40.text: Ketchup, mustard, smile. That's the job.

v_37eb690baf.speaker: walt
v_37eb690baf.text: Lamps dying outside? Shop light off.

v_0db7046e74.speaker: walt
v_0db7046e74.text: Long car? Shut it. Keep it shut.

v_0eec32dec6.speaker: walt
v_0eec32dec6.text: Long night, huh? Coffee's on me.

v_922fb14183.speaker: walt
v_922fb14183.text: Messed up? Toss it. No harm.

v_146c67bf64.speaker: walt
v_146c67bf64.text: Morning! Told you nights were quiet.

v_6a998d7bee.speaker: walt
v_6a998d7bee.text: Morning, Rookie! I'm on the line.

v_5e55db4a7b.speaker: walt
v_5e55db4a7b.text: My knees are done. But you... you notice things.

v_b826ff9af4.speaker: walt
v_b826ff9af4.text: Nice and normal. Sell some dogs.

v_98dcdc1f92.speaker: walt
v_98dcdc1f92.text: Nice. Here it comes, your first client.

v_2f3f900213.speaker: walt
v_2f3f900213.text: Now go to the cutting board and cut some bread.

v_2d26ffde0c.speaker: walt
v_2d26ffde0c.text: Now go to the toppings table and put the ketchup.

v_e9e95cf807.speaker: walt
v_e9e95cf807.text: Now take it and put it aside.

v_1ae72da760.speaker: walt
v_1ae72da760.text: One Mr. Pickett today, I hope.

v_089cce41c0.speaker: walt
v_089cce41c0.text: Only chance I get. Be careful.

v_e959ad766d.speaker: walt
v_e959ad766d.text: Plain dog. Go to the grill.

v_d8753a68f3.speaker: walt
v_d8753a68f3.text: Pop a frank in the bun.

v_e245baf6a4.speaker: walt
v_e245baf6a4.text: Potato sticks today. Bigger grill, too.

v_49de7dc12d.speaker: walt
v_49de7dc12d.text: Rookie, it seems that something weird is happening today... if you see someone showing up twice don't serve him.

v_9b6108722e.speaker: walt
v_9b6108722e.text: See the bubble? That's the order.

v_7c27354d0f.speaker: walt
v_7c27354d0f.text: Short on cash? I've got you.

v_0b669707f9.speaker: walt
v_0b669707f9.text: Shut the window. Keep it shut.

v_5495df0c7e.speaker: walt
v_5495df0c7e.text: Some customers have a neck problem, so if you see one, don't stare him, just give the food to him and your head down

v_2bd5e253a0.speaker: walt
v_2bd5e253a0.text: Somebody has to keep the light on. Every night.

v_84845b02f9.speaker: walt
v_84845b02f9.text: Someone across the street? Don't look.

v_738c3d9fb1.speaker: walt
v_738c3d9fb1.text: Take his plate at the countertop.

v_5134581f2b.speaker: walt
v_5134581f2b.text: Take the sausage from the cooler.

v_e06f57adaa.speaker: walt
v_e06f57adaa.text: Tap the frank box. Grill it.

v_f271c54c14.speaker: walt
v_f271c54c14.text: Ten nights. You kept the light on.

v_e0d63991ec.speaker: walt
v_e0d63991ec.text: That's your job. Call me if you need me.

v_83d0e946e7.speaker: walt
v_83d0e946e7.text: The corner's a crossing, Rookie. At night, the late crowd comes through.

v_86b4351c71.speaker: walt
v_86b4351c71.text: The lamps are dying! Run INSIDE the Mart, now!

v_d9a7a5ee99.speaker: walt
v_d9a7a5ee99.text: The lamps outside are dying! Kill the lights in here, NOW!

v_f3e7afb49b.speaker: walt
v_f3e7afb49b.text: The night shift is yours. If you want it.

v_a407bfc9ae.speaker: walt
v_a407bfc9ae.text: They like the light. And the smell of food. Heh.

v_57270a5e38.speaker: walt
v_57270a5e38.text: This is a plain dog. Deliver it to the customer.

v_3964010cb7.speaker: walt
v_3964010cb7.text: This is not what he asked. What are you doing? No, just toss it.

v_46d1362f8c.speaker: walt
v_46d1362f8c.text: This one wants ketchup, so just do the same thing as before for now.

v_16750f60c7.speaker: walt
v_16750f60c7.text: Well, it looks good. Just take it to the customer.

v_808accb026.speaker: walt
v_808accb026.text: What are you doing? I don't have the whole night. Take his order.

v_0fb843d28b.speaker: walt
v_0fb843d28b.text: You can choose something. I'm gonna pay for it.

v_79fe1b45ba.speaker: walt
v_79fe1b45ba.text: You kept your eyes down. Good.

v_7150b19925.speaker: walt
v_7150b19925.text: You work late tonight. I'll ring.
